question: Which of the following Union Ministries introduced the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Amendment Bill, 2024, in the Parliament in February 2024?

options.text: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Amendment Bill, 2024, was introduced by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** in February 2024.
 
• The amendment aims to strengthen existing laws related to the **prevention and control of water pollution** and enhance accountability mechanisms.
 
• The bill proposes to update penalties and compliance measures for industries and entities found violating pollution norms.
 
• The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change oversees policies and programs aimed at **environmental conservation, pollution mitigation, and climate change adaptation**.
 
• The amendment is aligned with India's commitment to achieving **sustainable development goals (SDGs)**, particularly SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974:**

 
 
• The original act was enacted to prevent and control water pollution and maintain or restore the wholesomeness of water in India.
 
• It led to the establishment of **Central and State Pollution Control Boards** for monitoring and enforcement.
 
• The act provides the framework for regulating industries and other entities that discharge waste into water bodies.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6):**
 
 
• SDG 6 aims to ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
 
• It emphasizes targets such as improving water quality, reducing pollution, and increasing water-use efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change:**
 
 
• The ministry is responsible for planning, promoting, coordinating, and overseeing the implementation of environmental and forestry programs.
 
• It plays a key role in formulating policies aimed at environmental protection and sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Water pollution:**
 
 
• Water pollution refers to contamination of water bodies such as lakes, rivers, oceans, and groundwater.
 
• Major causes include industrial discharge, agricultural runoff, and untreated sewage.
